Edward Hatt (born 22 December 1993) is an English footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Wessex League Premier Division club Cowes Sports and the Isle of Wight official team.
Club career
Newport (IOW)
Edward Hatt began playing football at the age of six or seven, and he began at Newport (IOW) where he joined the senior team in 2009 at the age of 16. As the reserve goalkeeper at Newport (IOW), he won the Isle of Wight Senior Cup in 2008–09 and 2010–11.
He was unable to make a single league appearance for the club before leaving in 2012.
Cowes Sports
He then joined Wessex League Division One club Cowes Sports ahead of the 2012–13 season. He debuted for Cowes Sports on 15 September 2012 during the 2–0 loss against Longwell Green Sports in the FA Vase second qualifying round. He was the main goalkeeper by the time Cowes Sports won promotion to the Wessex League Premier Division after achieving a runner-up finish in 2014–15.
He then won the Isle of Wight Senior Cup four times with Cowes Sports (2017–18, 2022–23, 2023–24, 2024–25), and he received an award in 2022 after making 400 appearances for Cowes Sports across all competitions.
International career
He debuted for Isle of Wight on 28 June 2015 during the 3–0 victory against the Falkland Islands at the 2015 Island Games. He also played at the 2023 Island Games where Isle of Wight finished in third place.
Personal life
His father and brother played as goalkeepers, and his brother also played cricket.
